fixed_scope.selection: Exactly the previous geometry gate rows; no target/geometry ranking, skip, replacement or expansion

method.quadratic_gradient: D=dN/d(r,s,t) [10,3]; J=X^T D [physical,reference]; G2=(u^T D)J^-1, compute transpose solve rather than explicit inverse; epsilon2=sym(G2), unitsdimensionless
method.physical_affine_extension: u_aff(X_a)=u0+G1(X_a-X0); delta_a=u_a-u_aff(X_a), all4corner delta zero. epsilon_mid=sym((delta^T D)J^-1). Require epsilon2=epsilon1+epsilon_mid for truth and prediction.
method.fixed_quadrature: 4 positive symmetric tetrahedron points: a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20, b=(5-sqrt(5))/20, each barycentric permutation of(a,b,b,b); reference weight1/24 each. w=abs(det J)/24 in mm^3. Exact polynomial energy for affine geometry/P2 displacement; only a fixed quadrature proxy for curved isoparametric geometry.
method.energy: Frobenius tensor inner product xx/yy/zz plus2*(xy/xz/yz). Error e1=eps1_pred-eps1_true; emid=epsmid_pred-epsmid_true; e2=e1+emid. E2=sum w||e2||F^2=E1+Emid+2sum w<e1,emid>F. Preserve signedcross, no abs or omission.
readouts: Selected-subset quadrature-weighted reference/error RMS and relativeL2 separately for P1 and P2-u-derived proxy; do not replace historical all-node recovered P1
Truth/prediction midside residual displacement RMS; E1/Emid/signedcross/E2 and identity residual
GT-proxy mismatch epsilon2_true-epsilon1_true weighted energy/RMS and ratio to sameP2 reference; truth and prediction reference energy denominator separately
Original selectedcorner volume and quadrature volume as different diagnostics, no exact curved-volume claim
method.zero_denominators: If exact reference energy is zero report ratio/relativeL2 null with explicit reason; no artificial floors, epsilon clipping or label transform.
